verdict.rationale: Published board power and cooling guidance are a fair axis for any GPU, so the story applies even though the B200 is a data-center part rather than a gaming card. The evidence never states a TDP/TGP figure, connector requirements or cooling guidance for the B200. It only says maximum per-GPU power is reported at runtime by nvidia-smi and describes DGX system-level PSU redundancy, which gives a buyer nothing to spec a build against.
